definitions.gloss: new ground; new frontier; new territory; new realm
definitions.explanation: A previously unexplored area of activity, thought, or creative expression. Used when someone breaks into a new field or achieves something unprecedented.

examples.japanese: {新境地|しんきょうち}を{開|ひら}いた{作品|さくひん}だ。
examples.english: It's a work that opened up new ground.

examples.japanese: ベテラン{俳優|はいゆう}が{新境地|しんきょうち}に{挑|いど}んでいる。
examples.english: The veteran actor is venturing into new territory.

examples.japanese: この{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{医療|いりょう}の{新境地|しんきょうち}を{切|き}り{拓|ひら}くものだ。
examples.english: This technology will pioneer new frontiers in medicine.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost always used with を{開|ひら}く (to open up) or を{切|き}り{拓|ひら}く (to pioneer). Carries a positive connotation of breaking new ground and expanding one's capabilities or achievements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新境地|しんきょうち}を{開|ひら}く (to open up new ground)
- {新境地|しんきょうち}を{切|き}り{拓|ひら}く (to pioneer new territory)
- {新境地|しんきょうち}に{挑|いど}む (to take on new territory)
- {新境地|しんきょうち}に{達|たっ}する (to reach new territory)
